faq_como_creo_una_cuenta: How do I create an account?
faq_desde_el_boton_registrarse_en_la_par: Use the “Sign up” button at the top to create a tenant or landlord account with your basic contact details.
faq_como_puedo_editar_mi_perfil: How can I edit my profile?
faq_puedes_actualizar_tu_nombre_telefono: You can update your name, phone number and preferences in your account settings.
faq_como_publico_una_propiedad: How do I list a property?
faq_si_tienes_una_cuenta_de_arrendatario: With a landlord account, you can create a listing with photos, price, address and the amenities available at your property.
faq_puedo_editar_una_propiedad_despues_d: Can I edit a property after publishing it?
faq_si_desde_tu_panel_de_propiedades_pue: Yes. From your property dashboard, you can update photos, price, description and availability at any time.
faq_como_busco_propiedades_por_zona_o_pr: How do I search for properties by area or price?
faq_desde_explorar_puedes_indicar_una_ub: In “Explore”, enter a location and price range; the list and map will show matching properties.
faq_que_hago_si_no_encuentro_propiedades: What if I can't find properties in my area?
faq_prueba_ampliar_el_rango_de_precio_o_: Try widening the price range or removing some filters; you can also clear the search in Explore.
faq_que_significan_los_servicios_verific: What do a property's verified amenities mean?
faq_son_datos_como_agua_electricidad_o_v: These are details such as water, electricity or internet speed that the landlord records so you know what the property offers.
faq_quien_define_los_servicios_disponibl: Who defines the amenities available at a property?
faq_el_arrendador_selecciona_los_servici: The landlord selects amenities from a catalog when creating or editing the listing.
faq_como_contacto_a_un_arrendador: How do I contact a landlord?
faq_dentro_del_detalle_de_cada_propiedad: On each property's detail page, you will find an option to start a conversation with the landlord through SafeRent's internal messaging.
faq_la_mensajeria_expone_mi_numero_o_cor: Does messaging expose my phone number or email?
faq_no_la_conversacion_ocurre_dentro_de_: No. The conversation takes place within SafeRent without directly sharing your contact details with the other person.
faq_como_funciona_el_sistema_de_resenas: How does the review system work?
faq_los_inquilinos_que_han_vivido_en_una: Tenants who have lived in a property can leave a review and rating, helping future renters learn about the real experience of living there.
faq_cualquier_inquilino_que_haya_tenido_: Any tenant with a recorded stay at the property can share their experience.
faq_como_reporto_una_publicacion: How do I report a listing?
faq_si_una_publicacion_te_parece_incorre: If a listing seems incorrect or suspicious, you can report it for review by SafeRent's moderation team.
faq_como_protege_saferent_mis_datos_pers: How does SafeRent protect my personal information?
faq_solo_mostramos_la_informacion_necesa: We only show information needed for the rental process; you can read more in our Privacy Policy.
